analysis: supplementary paired TreeSHAP shift; descriptive only

protocol.split: 80/20; patient-disjoint grouped stratified split for UCI Diabetes
protocol.mask: test-only 20% MCAR, one deterministic mask per dataset/model/seed
protocol.sample: up to 20 observations per audit group, shared clean/stress rows
protocol.explanation: RF/XGB use approximate TreeSHAP (Saabas, no exact SHAP consistency guarantee); LGB uses exact TreeSHAP because SHAP does not support approximate=True for LightGBM. Effects are compared within each model, not across model output scales.
protocol.note: not causal, not a stability guarantee, and not part of primary FMG results

input_path_redaction: Local absolute paths removed before repository packaging; hashes still identify the exact inputs.
